blurb: Guests join Captain Kevin Wasbauer on Atalanta, a custom Farr 53 sailing yacht, for day sailing trips on Monterey Bay or multi-day offshore sailing excursions along the West Coast and across the Pacific Ocean. Trips are suitable for beginners seeking offshore experience and advanced sailors. Captain Kevin is a seasoned professional racer and captain who provides high level sailing knowledge.
